messages:
maria: Quick triage request — onboarded FP8 kernels for atlas-13b on L40s (latest runtime). After ~2k tokens we see subtle semantic drift / repeated token collapse in ~1% of traces. Repro run + logs attached.

maria: repro:
```bash
./run_infer --model atlas-13b.fp8 --device l40s --seq 4096 --prompt-file test_prompts.jsonl --use-kv-cache
```
logs show repeated 'the' tokens and a drop in perplexity.

chris: what kind of drift? logits collapse or decoding loop? was this during interactive sampling or greedy?

maria: sampling (top-p 0.92, temp 0.8). short trace: "...the the the" then output turns generic. early attention scores look fine, but last-layer norm drops ~0.8x around token 2048-2100.

yusuf: could be accumulator saturation with FP8 after many KV appends. if you disable KV cache does it reproduce? any difference with fp16 kernel?

maria: quick local: disabling KV cache removes the failure. switching to fp16 kernel also stable. points to KV+FP8 path.

chris: try enabling the activation-scaling probe: set env DEBUG_FP8_SCALE=1 in runtime to log per-layer scale history, will show if scales collapse/oscillate.

maria: running that now, pushing logs to the ticket when done.

dev-bot: New triage ticket created: TI-4521 — "FP8 L40s post-2k semantic drift with KV cache" (logs attached).

yusuf: assigning to myself. I'll instrument per-step accumulator stats and check for bias in quant rounding. also compare per-head norm trajectories.

chris: note — short-term mitigation: warm restarts (zero accumulators between requests) reduces occurrence. not ideal for throughput but useful for repro.

maria: thanks. we'll also run AWQ and GPTQ baselines on the same prompt set to quantify quality deltas vs FP8. will post preliminary numbers in #eng-ml later. :thumbsup:
